name: Wontonee CommerIQ — AI Commerce Insights for WooCommerce
author: Saju Gopal

sections.description:
Transform Your WooCommerce Store with AI-Powered Intelligence

CommerIQ is the ultimate AI assistant for WooCommerce store owners who want to save time, increase sales, and stay competitive. Our powerful plugin connects to external AI services to automate the most time-consuming tasks while providing intelligent insights to help you make data-driven decisions.

Important: External Service Integration

This plugin connects to CommerIQ’s external AI services to provide its functionality. The plugin itself is free and fully functional, but requires API credentials to connect to our AI processing servers.

  • Service Provider: Wontonee (CommerIQ AI Services)
  • Service URL: https://myapps.wontonee.com/api/commeriq
  • What data is sent: Product titles, descriptions, prices, and images for AI processing
  • Terms of Service: https://wontonee.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://wontonee.com/privacy

All AI processing (content generation, image creation, price comparison) happens on our external servers as it requires significant computational resources that cannot be provided locally.

🚀 Key Features

AI Content Generation
* Generate compelling product descriptions instantly
* Create both short and long-form content
* SEO-optimized product copy
* Multiple content variations
* Perfect grammar and engaging tone
* Save hours of writing time

AI Image Generation
* Create stunning product images with AI
* Generate professional visuals from text descriptions
* Set featured images automatically
* Save images directly to media library
* No design skills required
* Unlimited creative possibilities

Intelligent Price Comparison
* Compare your prices across multiple platforms
* Real-time competitive analysis
* Track competitor pricing
* Identify pricing opportunities
* Make data-driven pricing decisions
* Stay competitive in your market

Smart Analytics & Insights
* Comprehensive product performance metrics
* Market trend analysis
* Competitive intelligence
* Actionable recommendations
* Beautiful, easy-to-understand reports

💡 Why Choose CommerIQ?

  • Save Time: Automate content creation and market research
  • Increase Sales: Optimize product presentations and pricing
  • Stay Competitive: Monitor market trends and competitor strategies
  • Professional Quality: AI-generated content and images that convert
  • Easy to Use: Intuitive interface, no technical skills needed
  • Seamless Integration: Works perfectly with WooCommerce
  • Regular Updates: Continuous improvements and new features

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce store owners
  • Online retailers
  • Dropshippers
  • Product managers
  • Marketing teams
  • Anyone selling products online

🔐 API Credentials

CommerIQ connects to external AI services for processing. To use the plugin:

  1. Get free API credentials at myapps.wontonee.com
  2. Enter your API key in the plugin settings
  3. Start using all AI-powered features immediately

The plugin is completely free and open source. API credentials are required only to connect to our AI processing service.

📚 Documentation & Legal

  • Terms of Service: https://wontonee.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://wontonee.com/privacy

Additional Information

Privacy & Data

CommerIQ respects your privacy. Product information sent to our AI servers is used solely for generating content and images. We do not store or share your product data beyond what’s necessary for providing the service.

Performance

CommerIQ is optimized for performance. AI operations are processed asynchronously to avoid blocking your store. Generated content and images are cached for quick access.

Compatibility

CommerIQ is tested with:
* Latest WordPress versions
* WooCommerce 6.0+
* All major WordPress themes
* Popular page builders
* Multi-language plugins

Support & Feedback

We value your feedback! Help us improve CommerIQ:
* Contact us: https://wontonee.com/contactus

About Us

CommerIQ is developed by Wontonee DigitalCraft LLP, a team dedicated to creating innovative solutions for e-commerce businesses. Visit us at wontonee.com

  • AI Technology powered by advanced machine learning models

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CommerIQ”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to WooCommerce > CommerIQ to configure your license

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to WooCommerce > CommerIQ to configure your license

Configuration

  1. After activation, navigate to WooCommerce > CommerIQ
  2. Go to the “License” tab
  3. Enter your license key and domain
  4. Click “Activate License”
  5. Start using AI-powered features!
sections.faq:
Do I need a license to use CommerIQ?

Yes, CommerIQ requires a valid license key to access all features. You can purchase a license at wontonee.com/commeriq

How do I generate AI content for my products?

  1. Go to any product edit page
  2. Find the “AI Content” button above the product description editor
  3. Click the button to generate compelling product descriptions
  4. Review and save your content

Can I generate images for existing products?

Yes! On any product edit page, click the “Generate AI Image” button in the Product Image section. The AI will create a professional image based on your product name and description.

How does price comparison work?

Navigate to the Price Comparison section in the product data area and click “Run Comparison”. CommerIQ will analyze prices across multiple platforms and provide competitive insights.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely! We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. Your data is transmitted securely and stored safely. We never share your information with third parties.

What happens if my license expires?

If your license expires, AI features will be disabled until you renew. Your existing content and images remain intact. Renew your license to continue using all features.

Can I use CommerIQ on multiple sites?

License terms vary by plan. Check your license details at wontonee.com/commeriq for multi-site availability.

How often is the plugin updated?

We regularly release updates with new features, improvements, and bug fixes. Updates are automatic through your WordPress dashboard.

Do you offer support?

Yes! Licensed users receive priority support. Contact us through our Support Center for assistance.

What are the server requirements?

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher
  • HTTPS (SSL certificate recommended)
